title: The file uploading speed is way slower in Gradio 4 than in Gradio 3
body:
### Describe the bug

I am using gr.File(...) to upload DXF file as input for the next step. But I noticed that the uploading speed is super slow when I upgrade my gradio 3.34.0 to gradio 4.4.0/4.5.0. To upload a file around 300KB, the previous uploading time is <100ms, but now it is around 5-10 seconds.
 
Any clue to explain this or solve this? 

### Have you searched existing issues?  🔎

- [x] I have searched and found no existing issues

### Reproduction

```
with gr.Blocks(title='demo') as demo:
    file_input = gr.File(file_types=['.dxf'], label='Please select a dxf file')

demo.launch(show_error=True, auth=('test','test'))
```

### Screenshot

_No response_

### Logs

_No response_

### System Info

```shell
python 3.10.12
gradio 4.4.0/4.5.0
```


### Severity

I can work around it

comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
@participant1 Hi, just realized the day after I submit the PR if you remember that, I also made some test on V4.X 

There are ways here I make the app online,

1. The nginx as front-end with default config and the python app as backend, using `proxy_pass`. Very slow, both my side and client side.
2. The nginx as front-end but with `client_max_body_size 100M;` config, my side is good, the client side needs to clean the cache or open another browser to make things well.
3. The `argo` expose the localhost python app to public, my side bad, client side bad.
4. The huggingface, my side good, client side bad.
